title: Neurogrip vision telemetry v1
description: Transport-neutral vision recommendation, never an actuator command. Millimetres are used only for calibrated/validated geometry. The controller separately authorizes all movement.

session_id.description: Random uint32 source boot/session identifier. A changed session needs an explicit receiver handshake; it must not silently rearm.

sequence.description: Increments for each packet, modulo 2^32. Accept only forward deltas in [1, 2^31-1] after session pairing.

timestamp_ms.description: Source monotonic milliseconds at serialization. Diagnostic only: source and controller clocks are not inherently synchronized.

capture_age_ms.description: Age from actual frame capture to serialization. Includes known inference/buffering delay. If actual sensor capture time is unavailable, an additional measured upstream delay budget is necessary.

valid_for_ms.description: Maximum total frame age, not a TTL starting at receipt. Receiver uses a local age cap as well. Runtime validates capture_age_ms < valid_for_ms for a permit.

mode.description: Synthetic/replay data uses SIMULATION and cannot carry a hardware permit.

direction.description: 0=BACKWARDS, 1=UPRIGHT, 2=FORWARDS, 255=UNKNOWN. Recommendation uses the physical directions agreed during stroke calibration, never an assumed image-axis mapping.

strike_permit.description: Vision condition only. A true heartbeat does not initiate or repeat a strike. Controller must receive its own separately armed one-shot request and enforce local interlocks.

gap_mm.description: Estimated finger-to-target surface gap in millimetres under calibrated geometry. Unknown is null; zero means estimated contact. Monocular depth is an estimate with scene-dependent error.

quality.description: Heuristic signal-quality score, not a calibrated probability and not proof of a collision-free path.

scale_valid.description: Metric calibration is accepted by application checks. Controller still requires its own validated error margin and calibrated reachable stroke.
